literal_facts: CCU names the Aligned Data Pad Project at Conesville, Ohio and expressly reports July 2026 completion of its earthworks scope.
Aligned's Ohio page names CMH-02 at Conesville and a 197-acre campus.
County minutes name Aligned Data Centers (Conesville) Propco LLC and parcel 010-00000806-09.
The county's exact PIN and OBJECTID 27692 return that same company and an isolated parcel reference point.
campus_association.analyst_reconciliation: These identify one Aligned Conesville campus. The selected official parcel point locates a constituent of the campus; the contractor report does not itself state CMH-02, parcel identifiers or coordinates.

distinctness_review.method: Read every selected campus name and physical key; search prior JSON research/curated sources and available v97 entity inventory for Conesville, CMH-02, CMH02 and Coal City; Shapely 2.1.2 intersects() against every full selected geometry, including polygon holes.
distinctness_review.preservation: No older matching key was found. One new proposed campus identity only; existing ODATA Brazil and all other selected rows remain unchanged.

successor_review.finding: No qualifying primary whole-campus completion or cancellation was located in bounded exact-campus searches. CCU completes only its site-preparation scope. Operator initial mid-2026 delivery is a historical forecast; standing uptime/design language is not a dated opening.
successor_review.unselected_third_party_conflict: Search surfaced directories inconsistently labelling the same CMH-02 campus operating and under construction. They are not first-party successors and no operational state is inferred.
